overview: The Medford Charter Study Committee reviewed and voted on draft charter provisions covering citizen participation mechanisms (Article 8) and financial procedures (Article 6). The committee also agreed to recommend budget-related charter review studies in its final report and set a five-year initial charter review timeline.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee voted to accept the minutes from the May 2, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Article 8: Citizen Participation
items.summary: The committee approved Article 8 after voting to reduce the free petition threshold to 25 signatures and the initial initiative petition requirement to 200 voters, while retaining referendum and recall provisions.

items.title: Article 6 Recommendation for Final Report
items.summary: The committee voted to include a recommendation in its final report for future charter reviews to examine municipal budgeting options, including participatory budgeting and council budget amendment powers, rather than drafting them into the charter.

items.title: Article 6: Financial Procedures
items.summary: The committee approved Article 6, revising language to require a joint annual budget meeting to review the city's financial condition and adjusting capital improvement plan submissions to occur within the first two years of a mayoral term.

items.title: Charter Review Intervals and Remaining Articles
items.summary: The committee voted to require a charter review five years after adoption and every ten years thereafter, and deferred discussions on committee composition and Articles 1, 5, 9, and 10 to the next meeting.
